symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1627 (ako/mxcli#1559): `describe module` of a module with a view entity whose OQL selects `t.ID as VE_Target` printed `create or modify association M.VE_Target from M.VE to M.Target`; `check --references` and `exec` then refused the module's own description as CE6771, nothing written
cause: describeModule listed every dm.Associations/CrossAssociations entry, and describeAssociation rendered each as a statement. A view entity's association carries Source DomainModels$OqlViewAssociationSource and is DECLARED by the OQL column, which the view entity's description already prints; there is no statement that can state it (a plain one is the CE6771 refusal itself)
fix: describe module skips associations whose Source is OqlViewAssociationSource; describe association on one prints a two-line `--` pointer to the view entity (zero statements), the plain association stays a statement
insight: **When a feature derives a member from another statement, every describer of that member kind needs to know** — the 2026-09-12 fix taught create/check/exec that the column IS the declaration, and the one emitter it did not touch was describe, so the platform-correct model described as a refused script. Grep the emitter's CALL SITES (here only describeModule and the `describe association` dispatch) rather than the reported command. The assertion that matters is not 'no association line' but `assertAgree(described, "")` — check AND exec accept the description — plus describe → exec → describe being a fixed point; the first alone would pass a describer that dropped the OQL column too. Controls: pre-fix the same tests fail with the CE6771 refusal text from both check and exec; a plain association in the same module must still describe as a statement. Measured 10.24.25: pre-fix check --references refuses and exec writes nothing; fixed, check passes, a fresh project gets the view entity AND its association from the OQL, mx check 0 errors, in-place re-run 'already in sync'. The report's 'adds a grant read line' did NOT reproduce on an mxcli-authored model with read *, read (Code) and read (Code, VE_Target) grants — it needs the Studio Pro-stored rule to diagnose
